caseName: United States v. California Midway Oil Co.
caseNameFull: United States v. California Midway Oil Company
summary: Appeal from the Circuit Court of Appeals -for the Ninth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. H. L. Underwood, Special Assistant to the Attorney General, with whom Mr. Solicitor General Beck was on the brief, for the United States. Mr. Geo. E. Whitaker and Mr. U. T. Clotfelter, for ap-pellees, submitted.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Affirmed upon the authority of Washington Securities Co. v. United States, 234 U. S. 76, 78; Baker v. Schofield, 243 U. S. 114, 118; Southern Ry. Co. v. Puckett, 244 U. S. 571, 574; Piedmont & Georges Creek Coal Co. v. Seaboard Fisheries Co., 254 U. S. 1, 13.
